problem:
Engineers are testing a water pump filling a reservoir.
They observe that water enters the reservoir at a rate $r(t)$ given by the function

$$
r(t)=12\sqrt{t+4},
$$

where $r(t)$ is measured in gallons per minute, and $t>0$ is the time in minutes since the pump was turned on.
At the same time, water leaks from the reservoir at a constant rate of $6$ gallons per minute.

If the reservoir was initially empty, find the expression that gives $V(t),$ the volume of water in the reservoir $t$ minutes after the pump was turned on.

$V(t)=$
{{field-1}}
$-\,6t-64$
